metadata.case_name: KONS SZE CHUNG BY HIS SISTER AND NEXT FRIEND KONG WAI PING v. SUNDO GARMENTS FACTORY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: student (law and administration, Shu Yan College)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: executive officer in the Government (civil service)
plaintiff.education_level: Second year of the 4-year law and administration course at Shu Yan College

injuries.description: Amputation of the distal portion of the thumb and all fingers on the left hand; severe burn injury to left hand
source: his left hand was drawn into the machine and severely burnt.
emergency operation to amputate the distal portion of the thumb and all fingers on the left hand of the first-named Plaintiff was performed upon admission to the hospital.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of two or more fingers at or near base, left hand

injuries.description: Removal/transplant of the second toe of the left foot (second toe taken for transplant to left palm); scarring of left foot
source: a transplant of the second toe of the left foot to the left palm was performed in September 1982.
there is a 5" scar at where the second toe was.

manifestations.description: Unable to run or play a number of ball games he used to play; social life affected (still plays table-tennis and badminton occasionally)
Grip in the left hand about 10 lbs (right 80 lbs); remnant of the thumb having a 30° movement and the new finger having a 40° movement; grip would never exceed 20 lbs
Difficulty in flexing the great toe and the third toe plantarwards
5" scar at where the second toe was
Embarrassment about his left hand; psychological distress; 'not a normal person' feeling and 'in a bad mood' leading to inactivity

treatments_received: Emergency amputation of the distal portion of the thumb and all fingers on the left hand
Abdominal skin flap raised to cover the raw wound (27 June 1981)
Two further minor operations to fashion the skin flap (20 July 1981 and 23 July 1981)
Bone trimming and new skin graft on thumb (8-11 September 1981)
Intensive physiotherapy at Special Clinic until March 1983
Transplant of the second toe of the left foot to the left palm (September 1982)
Fitted with a cosmetic hand (provided free)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could no longer run or enjoy a number of ball games he used to play.
Felt embarrassed about his left hand.
Social life affected as he can no longer play volleyball and basketball with his friends; still plays table-tennis and badminton occasionally.
